Name: Android Bigger Backpack
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Android Bigger Backpack extends the vanilla backpack progression on Android without replacing the normal 12 → 24 → 36 slot upgrades.

After reaching the vanilla 36-slot backpack, Pierre can sell five additional upgrades:

36 → 72 → 108 → 144 → 180 → 216 slots

Each extra upgrade adds one full 36-slot page. At the maximum size, the backpack has 216 real inventory slots across 6 pages.

Pierre's backpack display also changes with your progression: Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, then Prismatic.

The paging UI is designed for Android and works in the normal player inventory as well as the player-inventory side of chest/item-grab menus. The Organize button sorts the full expanded backpack.

[/list]

[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b][/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android only. This release is built and tested for the Android Stardew Valley/SMAPI environment.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Do not install it alongside another backpack-expansion mod. Known duplicate backpack systems are treated as conflicts and this mod will disable itself rather than stack them.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extra upgrades begin only after the vanilla 36-slot backpack is owned.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Standard prices: 25,000g / 50,000g / 100,000g / 200,000g / 500,000g.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Challenging prices: 100,000g / 250,000g / 500,000g / 1,000,000g / 2,000,000g.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]The page system uses real Farmer inventory slots, not separate fake storage.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
